principles: Block only on an explicit configured hard budget that is exceeded; unset/OFF = byte-identical dispatch
Never invent a budget (spec); a budget-check error proceeds, it does not wrongly block
Pure policy + predicate + blocked-record builder in-module (zero cross-module imports); minimal gated guard in the seam
The blocked path returns a well-formed dispatch result and skips the provider spawn (fail closed)
The blocked record supersedes the estimate; never counted as provider-reported usage
drivers: Operators need a hard token ceiling that prevents over-budget calls before any spend
It edits the dispatch control flow, so it must be bounded by the unset/OFF byte-identical invariant
The estimate already exists at the seam; the budget check slots in right after it

options.name: A: pure policy+builder in-module + minimal gated pre-spawn guard
cons: Alters control flow when budget set (intended)

options.name: B: inline the budget logic in lattice-dispatch.ts
cons: Untestable, bloats the dispatch path — rejected

chosen: A: pure policy+builder in-module + minimal gated pre-spawn guard
rationale: Keeping policy resolution, the over-budget predicate, and the blocked-record builder as pure in-module functions makes the control-flow change a tiny, testable, gated guard; the unset/OFF byte-identical invariant bounds the risk, and the budget-check-error-proceeds rule prevents the enforcement from causing spurious failures.

preMortem.scenario: Budget check wrongly blocks when no budget is configured
preMortem.mitigation: resolveHardBudget returns null (no enforcement) when unset/invalid; CHK-004 case (b) asserts spawn happens with budgetPolicyId=null

preMortem.scenario: Flag OFF runs budget code / changes behavior
preMortem.mitigation: Guard strictly inside isUsageLedgerEnabled(); OFF path unchanged; CHK-004 case (a) asserts byte-identical

preMortem.scenario: A budget-check error blocks a real dispatch
preMortem.mitigation: All budget work in try/catch; on error PROCEED (do not block) — local non-authority never invents a budget; tested

preMortem.scenario: estimatedInputTokens not available at the guard -> wrong/[]-comparison
preMortem.consequence: Budget never enforced or NaN compare
preMortem.mitigation: Extend recordDispatchPreflight to return estimatedInputTokens (or recompute via bytesCharsEstimator); CHK-001/003 test the comparison

preMortem.scenario: Blocked path returns a malformed dispatch result -> downstream breaks
preMortem.consequence: Caller crashes on a blocked dispatch
preMortem.mitigation: Return a well-formed result mirroring the existing failure-return shape; behavior reviewer + CHK-004 case (c) verify
